deployments_detail.use: Realising Our New Central Harbourfront x AI project using generative AI technology
Generative AI public-engagement tool for the Central Harbourfront design campaign letting users create design blueprints via prompts
AI-powered elevator control system with video analysis for people counting
AI-powered interior design generator for home visualizations

AI-based smart lift/elevator control at The Henderson uses video analytics to count passengers in cars and lobbies, assign vacant cars, avoid overcrowding, and auto-register calls by tracking people movement - going beyond standard destination control. [WSP (MEP consultant)]

Integrated Tenant Experience Analytic Platform (ITEAP) with AI-enabled energy optimization and predictive analytics models, enabling near real-time interaction between building operators, tenants and assets, and tracking/analysing tenant journeys through the building. [Arup (sustainability consultant)]

Bespoke Smart Office mobile app at The Henderson with AI and emotional-intelligence capabilities integrating smart parking, contactless building access, and environmental controls (windows, blinds, air conditioning) for tenants.

AI-based construction safety monitoring within the 4S Smart Site Safety System - including AI hazard/unsafe-behaviour detection, the I-Vision Smart Monitoring System on excavators (alerts when staff are nearby), and an A.I. Danger Zone Monitoring System to prevent falls from height, deployed at sites including New Central Harbourfront Site 3.

AI patrolling security robots deployed at managed property The Beverley Hills, designed to detect unusual situations and relay real-time updates to the backend property management system to enhance security operations.
Machine-learning chiller plant optimization at The Henderson uncovers and optimizes operation patterns to reduce HVAC energy consumption, integrated with the building management system.

Digital Twin building management system creating a virtual smart-building twin of The Henderson, providing real-time ESG/building performance data and analytics for intelligent building operation and tenant ESG tracking.

"Realising Our New Central Harbourfront x AI" public campaign used generative AI (text-to-image) tools to let participants generate design blueprints/concept maps for Site 3, with AI workshops teaching Midjourney and ChatGPT/generative AI. [Midjourney; ChatGPT]
